title: The overlap needs material too
hook: A 2cm overlap repeats along a 20cm edge. Where does its area go?

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Include a seam or overlap strip in area requirements.

misconception: Hidden overlap does not contribute to material area.
objective: Include a seam or overlap strip in area requirements.

claims.text: A 2cm overlap repeats along a 20cm edge. Where does its area go?
claims.source: Hook (meta.json hook; resource-specs.json "lh-overlap-material-area".hook), recorded as a claim per FC LH-1 "Hooks with no claim (25)" (W-367, 2026-10-14, demo-builder). A stipulated hypothetical scenario or question that the stage then computes; its numbers are the declared spec values (A=["*", ["+", "x", 2], 20]; B=["*", "x", 20]; x denotes Width, 20 to 60, start 30). Not a measurement. FC LH-4 (2026-10-14, fact-checker, W-380): verified (hook): question; the stage answers it: (x+2)×20 vs x×20, the 2 cm strip runs the 20 cm length and adds 40 cm² (640 vs 600 at 30 cm). Wording note: "repeats along" means the strip runs the full edge; not misleading enough to dispute. Record: company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH4-2026-10-14.md.
